import std/[strutils, sequtils, tables]

type
  Dir = enum north, east, south, west
  Robot = object
    pos: tuple[x, y: int]
    dir: Dir

proc move(r: var Robot, cmds: string) =
  for c in cmds:
    case c
    of 'A': inc r.pos.y
    of 'L', 'R': discard
    else: raise newException(ValueError, "bad " & $c)

template twice(body: untyped) = body; body

var r = Robot()
r.move("A")
let t = {"a": 1}.toTable
twice: echo r.pos, " ", t["a"], " ", @[1, 2].mapIt(it * 2)
